decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot is a flagship automation offering for precast concrete plants, and one year on the market is too short to judge it against aspirations, so an established firm with slack would keep it while results remain uncertain.

The de-shuttering robot is a modular part of the same robotics line and shares development and production resources, so there is no clear shortfall that would trigger problemistic search or justify dropping it.

The profile storage robot complements the shuttering systems in integrated plant solutions, and despite a possibly narrower market, too little time has passed to show a performance gap below aspiration.
The automatic shuttering robot addresses labour shortages in precast production, which fits the firm's core competence, so management would keep it while it builds market evidence.
